result.instructions: Tools for Bloomerang, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bloomerang data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run bloomerang_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bloomerang_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bloomerang_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. bloomerang_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Bloomerang user the API key belongs to — name, email and permission level. A cheap way to confirm the key works and see what it may do. Bloomerang: GET /user/current.

tools.name: bloomerang_search_constituents
tools.title: Search constituents
tools.description: Full-text search across constituents (individuals and organizations) and households by name, email, etc. Start here to find a donor's Id. Bloomerang: GET /constituents/search.

search.description: Text to search for, e.g. a name or email.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_constituents
tools.title: List constituents
tools.description: List constituents with filters — by Id, type, favorites, last-modified date, or a custom field value — and sorting. Good for syncing recent changes. Bloomerang: GET /constituents.

is_favorite.description: Only constituents the key's user has favorited.

last_modified.description: Only records last modified after this date/time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31).

custom_field_id.description: Custom field Id to filter by.

custom_field_value.description: Custom field value to filter by.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_constituent
tools.title: Get one constituent
tools.description: Fetch one constituent's full profile — names, primary and secondary contact details, household, communication preferences, engagement score and custom values. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent (not the CRM AccountNumber).

tools.name: bloomerang_get_constituent_timeline
tools.title: Get a constituent's timeline
tools.description: The activity timeline for a constituent — gifts, interactions, notes, tasks and more, newest first. Pass a household Id to get the timeline of every member. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}/timeline.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent or household (not the CRM AccountNumber).

tools.name: bloomerang_list_constituent_relationships
tools.title: List a constituent's relationships
tools.description: Relationships between this constituent and others (spouse, employer, board member ...), with the role on each side. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}/relationships.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent (not the CRM AccountNumber).

last_modified.description: Only records last modified after this date/time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31).

tools.name: bloomerang_get_household
tools.title: Get one household
tools.description: Fetch a household — its names, head of household (HeadId) and member constituent Ids. A constituent's HouseholdId points here. Bloomerang: GET /household/{id}.

household_id.description: The API Id of the household (not the CRM AccountNumber).

tools.name: bloomerang_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions (gifts)
tools.description: List transactions — donations, pledges, pledge payments, recurring donations and their payments — with their designations (fund, campaign, appeal). Filter by constituent, amount range, type or last-modified date. Read only. Bloomerang: GET /transactions.

transaction_numbers.description: Only these TransactionNumbers (called Payment Number in CRM reporting).

types.description: Only transactions with at least one designation of these types.

last_modified.description: Only records last modified after this date/time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31).

tools.name: bloomerang_get_transaction
tools.title: Get one transaction
tools.description: Fetch one transaction with its payment method, amounts, refund status and every designation (fund, campaign, appeal, tribute, acknowledgement status). Bloomerang: GET /transaction/{id}.

transaction_id.description: The API Id of the transaction (not the CRM AccountNumber).

tools.name: bloomerang_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: List the funds gifts can be designated to (e.g. General Operating, Scholarship). Bloomerang: GET /funds.

is_default.description: Only the default (true) or non-default (false) fund.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns with their goals and dates. Bloomerang: GET /campaigns.

has_goal.description: Only campaigns with a non-zero (true) or zero (false) goal.

last_modified.description: Only records last modified after this date/time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31).

tools.name: bloomerang_list_appeals
tools.title: List appeals
tools.description: List appeals — the specific asks (a year-end letter, a gala invitation) that gifts are attributed to. Bloomerang: GET /appeals.

last_modified.description: Only records last modified after this date/time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-31).

tools.name: bloomerang_list_interactions
tools.title: List interactions
tools.description: List logged interactions (calls, emails, meetings, letters ...) — filter by constituent, channel or purpose. Bloomerang: GET /interactions.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally for specific constituents. Bloomerang: GET /notes.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (follow-ups) — filter by status, due-date range, assignee user, constituent, channel or purpose. Bloomerang: GET /tasks.

min_due_date.description: Due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

max_due_date.description: Due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

assignee_user_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these user Ids.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_constituent
tools.title: Create a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: create a new individual or organization constituent. For an individual give first_name/last_name; for an organization give full_name. Search first (bloomerang_search_constituents) to avoid creating a duplicate donor. Bloomerang: POST /constituent.

prefix.description: Must match a prefix configured in the CRM, e.g. Mr., Ms., Dr.

suffix.description: Must match a suffix configured in the CRM.

full_name.description: Organization name, or an explicit individual full name.

State.description: Must match a state configured in the Bloomerang CRM.

Country.description: Must match a country configured in the Bloomerang CRM.

Number.description: The phone number, formatting allowed, without the extension.

tools.name: bloomerang_update_constituent
tools.title: Update a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing constituent's profile (names, job, status, primary address/email/phone). Only the fields you supply are sent. Bloomerang: PUT /constituent/{id}.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent (not the CRM AccountNumber).

prefix.description: Must match a prefix configured in the CRM, e.g. Mr., Ms., Dr.

suffix.description: Must match a suffix configured in the CRM.

full_name.description: Organization name, or an explicit individual full name.

State.description: Must match a state configured in the Bloomerang CRM.

Country.description: Must match a country configured in the Bloomerang CRM.

Number.description: The phone number, formatting allowed, without the extension.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_interaction
tools.title: Log an interaction
tools.description: WRITE: log an interaction with a constituent — a call, email, meeting, letter, etc. — on their timeline. Bloomerang: POST /interaction.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent (not the CRM AccountNumber).

is_inbound.description: True if the constituent initiated it.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a constituent's record. Bloomerang: POST /note.

constituent_id.description: The API Id of the constituent (not the CRM AccountNumber).

tools.name: bloomerang_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a follow-up task, optionally tied to a constituent and assigned to a user (find user Ids via bloomerang_get_current_user or existing tasks). Bloomerang: POST /task.

assignee_user_id.description: User Id to assign it to.

send_notifications.description: If true, Bloomerang emails the assignee about the task. Default false.
